steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She doesn't.... look right...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The Originium crystals floating in the air beside her.... How is that possible?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's repulsive dissociation...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Did the Originium crystals permeate her skin to form black ice crystals along with the water molecules in the air?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Permeate....? Permeation?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doesn't it hurt! Doesn't that hurt her?!!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Don't you feel pain, white rabbit?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Enough... That's enough... Why are you doing this? Stop it!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmmng..... Nnnng!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya? I don't like the look on your face.... Wait!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Amiya, don't do it! Don't reach into her mind!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I didn't... I'm not using Arts! But her emotions.... Her emotions are pouring into my consciousness...!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I've been waiting for you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You want to kill Reunion's commander, don't you?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Now she's standing right in front of you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Here's your target. Get hot, burning hot.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hot...?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is that.... Her emotions...!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Team, stand by!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: FrostNova, we don't need to waste our breath here!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Lungmen exiled the Infected without a care as to where they could go. They are not coming.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even though there were still thousands of Infected people in the city.... Lungmen resigned them to their fate.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No one will interfere in our fight.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: So many of us.... against you alone?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What else?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Honestly, we're a little outnumbered. No one should be stupid enough to take an avalanche head on.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But actually, head on against an avalanche, I think I'd come out on top?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But you're one of those.... like where all the cold in the world gathers up into a single focal point.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I thought your Yeti Squad was pushing your abilities to the limit, making your Arts more powerful and effective.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I was wrong. They didn't make you stronger.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's your Arts that made them stronger.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: As long as my brothers and sisters are with me, I can't risk hurting them by releasing my full power.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But now. They're all dead.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: There are no living things left around me.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Hmm!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: The temperature has dropped dramatically....

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Not good! Such a low temperature.... it's thrown off my instruments!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I no longer have any reason to contain the winter within me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What the hell? Does Reunion have its own walking Catastrophe?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What is the lowest temperature Originium Arts has ever achieved? I've got a feeling she's breaking records one after another right now...

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: FrostNova, I'll ask you again, are you serious about this?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Anything else you want to say?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ——Knock it off, white rabbit, you're going to get yourself killed.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You're really going to die! You're strong enough already! You don't have to push it this hard!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You don't have to do this to get a fight! If you want to fight, fight all you want after this!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I don't want to see Infected killing each other!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's no reason for us to fight to the death here!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Ready up!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Pfft!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She froze my fingernails. They're cracking.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You really want to kill us?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I have a reason.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: As commander, I've lost.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ——but as a warrior, I'm still in the fight.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Amiya-1, Blaze-4, all units, do you copy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Exit the area. Now.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You too, Gavial!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because you can't come back to save us if you don't get out now!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Who's the best sniper in our squad?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You might die. Are you sure you want to volunteer?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: I'm sure. I am the best, at the moment.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Okay, GreyThroat, you stay. Everyone else, get the hell out.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hurry!

options: Why did you withdraw your team during a decisive battle?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Up against FrostNova, the number of squads doesn't make a difference. They have no way to protect themselves. And she can kill in an instant.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: There's not much you can do, even with someone as skilled as Rangers. It's not the archery, it's the materials.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: My crossbow seems to be useless already.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It'll be good for a bit. But you decide whether it works or not....

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If it was up to me, I'd take a few shots at her with Rhodes Island's main guns. That'd be pretty helpful.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Or conjure up a dozen fireteam to spray ammo and Arts into her to see what she can take.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: She'll run out of steam eventually. But... maybe not before we do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did you bring a tourniquet?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You should ask me if I have any anticoagulants with me, the kind that won't mess up.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze....

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...You asked earlier why FrostNova could endure the pain of Originium crystals piercing her skin?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know why. I can feel it.....

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She could endure it because the pain inside her was worse... Several times worse.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Now, Doctor, you need to go too.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor!
...Do you want to see it through...?
...To be a trustworthy Doctor...?

options: I want to see it through.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ...Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I... Dr. {@nickname} is.... committed.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Doctor of Rhodes Island.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Your decision won't do them any favors.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: So why do you do it?

options: I told you, you can come to Rhodes Island.
And I will fight shoulder to shoulder with my operators.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I get it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze, GreyThroat, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's going to be an uphill battle.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hmph. Heh heh.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Check it out, white rabbit, that's our Dr. {@nickname} and Amiya!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Don't do this...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Whatever.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Are you ready?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Let's get started!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Forward! Explosion!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: A fine attack.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: ——Ice blades?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Pfft!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Kitten, do you think I'm a caster.... So frail?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Are you serious?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The heat currents writhing on your saw blades are no match for my cold. You cannot stop my frost.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: I didn't underestimate you, but I didn't think....

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: My saw can cut through a city wall, and you can block it?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: To me, your movements, your strength, it doesn't even register.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Next we go for the throat.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Air! Compression! Demolition!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *Cough*, hahahahaha, *cough*.... Pfft! That was a close call, I almost got an ice blade through my jugular!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah, that's right. You're a warrior just like me.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What do I do, Amiya? I'm running out of ideas.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Time to tag you in.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Amiya... My finger is getting too cold to pull the trigger.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: We have to end this quickly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Her Originium Arts are a hundred times stronger than they were back in the ruins...!)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (And she's not out of tricks yet!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (It won't be enough.... If I don't loosen my rings, everyone will freeze to death!)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova--

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't even think about it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My finger?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh.... Gah!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I watched your entire battle with Talulah. Tweaking these rings enhances your Arts.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ten rings, all of them.... Frozen?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You are too childish to be a warrior.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: So you chilled a few rings? You've got a mouth on you, don't you?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Huh? What the...? I turned up the heat this high and they're not melting at all?)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze.... Stop it, don't waste blood. This is..... This is a very powerful, and very fine Originium Art...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The cold stream swept along the Originium crystals and wrapped around us as we entered the area.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She hit us with it before it could get cut off by your thermal currents, without us even noticing!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mmmf.... My Arts can't cut through!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The battle began as soon as you set foot in this room.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: These ten frost rings will drain your body heat and squeeze your Originium Arts. The more power you apply to them, the stronger and colder the ice crystals become.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Pathetic.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Eruption? Energy store? Reserves?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Trying to defeat me with a few tricks.... Do you know what you're up against?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: GreyThroat, piercing bolt!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Roger! Six shot, ready!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The Talulah I knew would engineer your demise long before it all began.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Air compression! Fire!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Loose!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And now Rhodes Island is just like these bolts....

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Wha...? What? Why did the bolt...? Freeze in midair?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Truly pathetic.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (She knocked it off course with her air streams, then broke it with cold?!)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (GreyThroat, what are your arrows made of?)

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: (It's Rhodes Island standard-issue, carbon fiber hybrid aluminum.)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Oh no. Ugh, we're in trouble.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even, somewhat shameful.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Whether she knows it or not, her Arts have reached a level that's well beyond anything the damned scholars are talking about these days.)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just a little pinch.... And you fall to pieces.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Think about it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I'm just the leader of Yeti Squad. Reunion is controlled by the woman named Talulah who intercepted you at Chernobog and killed your friends.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What do you think Talulah is...? The leader of Reunion, the Infected messiah?

options: She didn't earn the title of messiah!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Whatever image you have of her in your head, if she were some kind of 'messiah', the old man and I wouldn't be leading 'Reunion' at all.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: She was at first a military officer, then a warrior, and finally a leader.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But she has betrayed us.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The most determined and committed warrior I've ever known was actually a case of assumed identity...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: And her last remaining enemies are people like you who have no resolve and never had to look death in the face.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Watch your tone, white rabbit. You're not the only one who puts her life on the line.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You have remorse in your eyes too.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You don't have to tell me!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You're not ready to accept their deaths.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's enough!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough*, haha, *cough*....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Am I ready?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: *Cough*.... *Cough*!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I've thought about it so many times, seen them dying so many times in my nightmares, I just never thought...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You're the same way, kitten. I can see that.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'I imagined my tragic death, but I never thought it would be so lonely.'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You had brothers. So did I.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The Rhodes Island operators who fought Talulah at Chernobog were each quite heroic.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: The one they called Ace was a warrior tenacious to a level I've rarely seen in my life. He fought with an emotion few warriors do.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...'Sorrow.'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: We're not close enough yet that I'm really comfortable talking about my old battle buddies with you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Only a fighter who incessantly reflects on his battles would be concerned. He was a good warrior.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: As are you.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: He died alone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Are you sorry you lost him?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Do you regret not having the chance to save him?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Absolutely!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Aren't you going to ask anyone?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Ask.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Ask that question you don't know how to form, that you don't know who to ask.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'Why?'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (.......Such strong emotions.... FrostNova!)

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why wasn't I there? Why wasn't I stronger? Why didn't I stop it?

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Ugh.... The temperature is still dropping!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Stand by me! Her cold is so overpowering, it's all I can do to keep the air around me warm!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why did I fall to the ground when my brothers and sisters needed me most?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: They're all fools. All fools who only know how to help each other, who only want to survive, who only want a place to live.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Why can't I even grant the wishes of a bunch of idiots?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why is Ursus so cruel to our people, and so callous to ordinary Ursus?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why is it that the little flame that could ignite the world has to be extinguished in this foreign land?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why is it that in the war we waged to put a stop to evil, I wasted more lives?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough*, *cough*.... Unf, *cough*, *cough*...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Unf.... Ugh....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why did we give up our lives, *hack*, only to have achieved a lie?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why...? Why won't this world give me a little more time?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'The Infected should be proud of who they are, and use the simplest means to seize justice from the world'....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: At first, I saw it as only a part of the Reunion ideal.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Indeed, it brought strength to the Infected. They stopped thinking of themselves as the Empire's fodder....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But now I realize that the beliefs that Talulah once taught us about, the ideas that demand grassroots support, and the goals that must be constantly reinforced and corrected, are all gone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Only instigation. Only indulgence. We were thrown into the toughest of battles, with no input in the ranks, and it all came too soon....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If this is all Talulah's doing, then she deceived everyone from the very beginning.

options: Things are often not as they seem.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If she would take the Infected to that darkest of futures.... To complete her most wicked plan...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Then her evil must be destroyed.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: But my brothers and sisters, the countless dead Infected and uninfected....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Nothing can bring them back.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...What made her this way?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ugh.... Ugh...!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It shouldn't be like this, it never should have been!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: My people.... My brothers and sisters!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Amiya

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Do you hear that, Amiya?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova..!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The cold stream is too much.... She can even condense it into a form!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It's blasting away my heat flow!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Is the cold enough to chill your body heat? Is death enough to make you squeamish?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You won't, Amiya, and you can't!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You can read minds, can't you, bunny?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Read now, then, my rage, the heart that has been stifled by bitterness and boiled in my breast for more than a decade, and yet never given up beating!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Read it, Amiya! Read it well!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: How much anger is there in this heart, over dead loved ones, over the corrupt Ursus, over the Infected, over the people of Ursus, in this heart that will not stop, that will not die!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Did you ever hate her, Miss FrostNova?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...*Cough*.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I never hated her.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Even if she was the cause of all this pain today, I have never hated her.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What does hatred bring you and me?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I have nothing but endless, seething rage for this despicable planet.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: How about you?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't you have such anger in your heart?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Don't you have relatives who died of Oripathy? A friend who died thanks to the indifference of this world?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You haven't lost the people you depend on to survive, to give you something to live for?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Just proclaiming a certain philosophy, just taking on a certain Art, just organizing a few teams....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Will that be enough to defeat Talulah?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: It's time to wake up from your fantastical dreams.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I get it, Miss FrostNova.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everything that just flooded into my mind, I know what it is.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What's pushing Rhodes Island forward? What motivates you to keep fighting?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Dead ahead! A huge cold stream! It's about... Just about... the shape of a dagger!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: If this keeps up, I'll have to surrender my back and gather the heat flow in front of me as a shield....

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: But her cold stream was robbing the air of its molecular vibrations. Even if I managed to form the shield, I couldn't hold it for long!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Doctor, come on, you must have some idea!

options: Since we can't break it, we'll just have to hold on!

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's like saying nothing!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: No... The Doctor is right.

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: FrostNova doesn't have much life left in her. If we can hold out, we win.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: What are you talking about? If we do that, she'll die!

options: It was her choice, and the only chance she left us!

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What about your choices?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: In the face of the evil that must be destroyed, in the face of the betrayer who has usurped the ideals of the Infected, what is in your heart? Why does it beat?

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Cough*, *cough*.... If you can't even defeat me, how are you going to face her? How are you going to lead the countless Infected? How are you going to fight against this malignant world!!!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I can't be mad at you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Are wasting my time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, FrostNova... I know what I'm going to do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can't really read minds. And reading hearts doesn't mean I can understand someone better than people who don't have this ability.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I just can't refuse.... I can't shut out the emotions that pour out of you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Flooding my mind with pain and worry, and....

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Anger.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You're sober and calm, but the anger burns so hot that I want to pull back...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I can't. FrostNova, I know exactly what I have to do. I will not refuse you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss FrostNova, I felt it.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Why are you crying?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: FrostNova... You.....

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: No. Wipe your tears! You will not cry before your enemy.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Amiya, tell me your answer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Mhm.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: 'If we must fight, then we fight to the end.'

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, we are going to fight FrostNova.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Only one side walks out of here.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Yes. You will now... fight me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Only one of us leaves.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: If you can defeat me, it means some will be able to survive——

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: I am willing to join Rhodes Island. I am willing to fight together with you against the enemies of the Infected, your way.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: This is my burden to bear.

options: I hope you keep your word.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: When I make a promise, I keep it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And.... Miss FrostNova.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Infected don't need anyone to lead them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're just fighting for the same beliefs, not for any one person.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Never for any one person.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ——That's right. Corruption must be eradicated. Defeat me, and defeat Talulah.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: What are you?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I can be anyone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Who are you fighting for?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: For everyone.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Good. Amiya...

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: *Hack*.... Thank you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: 'Even time itself will freeze here.... ♪'

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: The cold is moving in on us! GreyThroat!

steps.name: GreyThroat
steps.text: Ready!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, stay by my side. I'll try to protect you.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: You will die here in battle, and I will extinguish your absurd fantasies.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: Or, defeat me.

steps.name: FrostNova
steps.text: ...Defeat me. And show me hope.
